greetings: We counted your heartbeats before you arrived.
Your vessel contains one more shadow than its manifest.
Do not look behind the voice.
We recognize the shape of your hunger.
offers: The spice remembers the hands that carried it. We have removed the hands.
Twelve sealed measures. None of them are asleep.
The cargo is yours if you agree that we have never met.
farewells: Leave before the second mouth opens.
Keep your receiver dark on the inward passage.
